tagline: Feeding the world while driving sustainability and decarbonization
hero_kpi_rationale: The operating margin reflects Yara's ability to generate profit in a volatile fertilizer sector, impacted by energy costs and raw material prices.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue that remains after deducting direct production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin is affected by the volatility of natural gas prices and nitrogen-based raw material costs.
kpis.signal: Margin under pressure due to energy costs and raw material prices.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profit generated before taxes and other financial charges, expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin declined in 2023 due to lower fertilizer volumes and prices.
kpis.signal: Margin compression linked to the tight macroeconomic environment.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue invested in research and development.
kpis.description: Yara is investing in agronomic innovation and precision fertilization technologies, including Yara Digital Farming with AI-based predictive models.
kpis.signal: R&D focused on low-carbon solutions and agricultural digitalization.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets to maintain or expand production capacity.
kpis.description: 2023 capex includes green hydrogen projects and Scope 1 emissions reduction initiatives.
kpis.signal: Increased capex to strengthen energy resilience and decarbonize sites.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: Yara maintains a stable workforce while strengthening its digital and sustainability teams.
kpis.signal: Slight headcount reduction in the context of operational optimization.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 22.0 NOK in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.127 Bn NOK in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 9.3% in the latest year.

ai_positioning.summary: Yara takes a cautious approach to artificial intelligence, gradually integrating it into its agronomic tools and digital farming platforms. The focus is on input efficiency and sustainability rather than disruptive innovation.
evidence: Deployment of Yara Digital Farming with AI-based predictive models
Use of nitrogen application optimization algorithms
Regional partnerships to test data-driven agricultural solutions
